hooks.name: Pick up where the last session stopped
hooks.description: At the start of a session, orient the agent: current branch and changes, the next open spec task, and the backlog in product.md.

action.prompt: Before starting, orient yourself in Draft Creature Lab: run `git status --short` and `git log --oneline -5`, open the backlog in .kiro/steering/product.md, and find the first unchecked task in .kiro/specs/*/tasks.md (in backlog order). Reply with one short paragraph: what changed recently, and the next task you would work on. Do not start editing until the user agrees.
